release_note.en: FP32 conversion, fixed NYC scenes and verified January API dates work on Mac; persistent forecast records are in development.
release_note.ja: FP32変換、固定NYC場面、照合済み1月のAPI日時をMacで検証済み。予測の永続記録は開発中。

note.en: Fixed scenes and the independently verified January 2025 API range are connected. The earlier API GUI route is checked; final range UI verification is recorded in the evidence. User acceptance remains open.
note.ja: 固定場面と独立照合済みの2025年1月API範囲を接続。前版のAPI GUI経路を確認済みで、最終範囲UIの結果は検証記録へ対応する。本人受入は未完。

note.en: Fixed/API UI and native adapter are connected; signed build passed. Physical iPhone inference and UI acceptance remain open.
note.ja: 固定/API画面と推論adapterを接続し署名build成功。実iPhoneの推論とUI受入は未確認。

conversion-20261111.toolchain:
Xcode 27.2
Build version 27B52; Swift 6.4.2; macOS SDK 27.2; Python 3.11.9; chronos-forecasting 2.3.2; torch 2.9.0; coreai-torch 0.4.3; coreai-core 1.0.0b3
conversion-20261111.backend: Python Core AI GPU preference; actual delegate not profiled
conversion-20261111.route: Chronos-2 recipe: independent official CPU reference -> Core AI native verification -> bundle

workload.en: 18 fixed synthetic series, raw length 1-8192, missing values and constant/periodic/trend inputs; all 21 quantiles x 16 forecast steps. One inference per case, no warmup. This measures numerical fidelity only.
workload.ja: 固定の合成18系列、raw長1〜8192、欠損・定数・周期・傾向。21分位×16点を全件比較。条件ごとに1回、warmupなし。数値一致だけの検査。

conversion-20261111.power: AC Power sampled before and after the run
conversion-20261111.thermal:
Note: No thermal warning level has been recorded
Note: No performance warning level has been recorded
Note: No CPU power status has been recorded; same after the run; temperature and GPU utilization not measured

swift-20261112.toolchain: Xcode 27.2 (27B52); Swift 6.4.2; macOS/iOS SDK 27.2; Debug package
swift-20261112.backend: Swift Core AI GPU preference; actual delegate not profiled

workload.en: 18 fixed cases / 6048 raw values, then release/reload and the first 336 values again. Numerical validation, no warmup or performance benchmark. Power/thermal and a benchmark-plan hash were not recorded.
workload.ja: 固定18条件・6048原値、その後の解放/再ロードで先頭336値を再照合。warmupなしの数値検証で性能比較ではない。電源/熱とbenchmark計画hashは未記録。

models-20261112.toolchain: Xcode 27.2 (27B52); Swift 6.4.2; SDK 27.2; Debug package tests; Release Mac/iOS applications
models-20261112.backend: ManagedModelStore and normal Mac Models UI; no inference
models-20261112.route: Local bundle import -> inspect -> ready -> lease/release; explicit preview

workload.en: Pinned nine-file bundle import, five rejected replacements, lease gating and source-hash preservation; normal Mac import/preview and signed iOS build. No inference or performance measurement.
workload.ja: 固定9ファイルの導入、5種類の不正置換拒否、leaseと元hash保持。通常Mac画面で導入・プレビュー、署名iOS build。推論・性能計測は行わない。

demo-20261112.toolchain: Xcode 27.2 (27B52); Swift 6.4.2; SDK 27.2; Debug package and Release Mac application
demo-20261112.backend: Swift Core AI GPU preference; actual delegate not profiled
demo-20261112.route: Normal Mac Models -> explicit on-device prediction -> interval and clock changes -> leave/reopen; separate production-service native comparison

workload.en: 60 fixed scene/zone cases / 20160 raw values; native Mac GUI prediction and comparison, then close. CPU fakes cover stop/owner boundaries. No iPhone inference, user acceptance or performance measurement. Power/thermal and a benchmark-plan hash were not recorded.
workload.ja: 固定60場面/ゾーン・20160原値。通常Mac画面で端末内予測・比較・離脱を確認。停止とowner境界はCPU fakeでも検査。iPhone推論・本人受入・性能計測は未実施。電源/熱とbenchmark計画hashは未記録。

api-20261112.toolchain: Xcode 27.2 (27B52); Swift 6.4.2; SDK 27.2; Debug package and Release Mac application
api-20261112.backend: Swift Core AI GPU preference; actual delegate not profiled
api-20261112.route: Production Models/Store/Service with a pinned January API reference; separate normal Mac GUI

workload.en: The production client validates all 29,760 January counts. The native path compares 20,160 Friday inputs and 6,720 raw outputs, then closes with zero leases. Normal Mac checks cover explicit acquisition/prediction/actuals and the verified month-end stop; chart accessibility fixes have separate source attribution. No controlled performance measurement or iPhone inference.
workload.ja: 本番clientで1月全29,760値を照合。native経路は金曜20,160入力・6,720原値とclose後lease0を確認。通常Macで明示取得/予測/実績と月末停止を確認。チャートAX修正の版は別記。制御した性能計測とiPhone推論は未実施。

note.en: Nine-file local bundle, including reference vectors and metadata; not runtime memory.
note.ja: 参照ベクトルとmetadataを含む9ファイルのローカルbundle。実行メモリではありません。

note.en: Maximum absolute error over all scalars; each value passed atol 1e-4 + rtol 1e-4. n counts scalar comparisons, not independent runs.
note.ja: 全scalarの最大絶対差。各値はatol 1e-4 + rtol 1e-4を満たす。nは比較したscalar数で独立run数ではありません。

note.en: 18 synthetic cases, 60 fixed NYC scene/zone cases and 20 live API series pass frozen raw-tensor comparisons. The API inputs overlap the fixed Friday workload.
note.ja: 合成18条件・固定NYC60場面/ゾーン・実API20系列が凍結した原tensor照合に合格。API入力は固定金曜の条件と重複。

note.en: Numerical fidelity and fixed-scene operation do not establish held-out forecasting quality.
note.ja: 数値一致と固定場面の操作は未使用データの予測品質を示すものではありません。

note.en: Release/reload, fixed and API production-service runs with zero leases, and normal Mac leave/reopen are checked. No memory measurement or iPhone acceptance.
note.ja: 解放/再load、固定/APIの本番service実行とlease0、通常Mac離脱/再表示を確認。メモリ計測とiPhone受入は未実施。

note.en: CPU fakes cover cancellation and stop joins; cancellation of the native model and normal app remain unmeasured.
note.ja: 取消と停止joinはCPU fakeで検査済み。実モデルの取消と通常アプリは未計測。
